name: Axeptio
project_description: Integrates the Axeptio.eu consent management platform (CMP) with Drupal. When a project id is configured, the module loads the Axeptio SDK (//static.axept.io/sdk.js) on every page and passes the client/project id and cookie settings to it via drupalSettings, so the Axeptio consent banner/widget appears. It supports Google Consent Mode v2 default signals (analytics_storage, ad_storage, ad_user_data, ad_personalization), a per-language cookie-version option, and an 'Axeptio iframe' text-format filter that neutralises embedded iframes (YouTube, Google Maps, Dailymotion, plus a pluggable vendor system) so third-party embeds only load after the visitor grants consent. Configure at Configuration > System > Axeptio.
